block_node.block_desc:
Attitude and Heading Reference System.
The block outputs orientation and bias-corrected angular velocity from IMU measurements. Tune the measurement noises to match a specific sensor. Tune the environmental noises to match the motion characteristics.

Estimate orientation using a complementary filter.
The block estimates device orientation and angular velocity by fusing data from accelerometer, gyroscope, and magnetometer.
Tune the accelerometer gain, and magnetometer gain to specify how much the accelerometer, and magnetometer measurements are trusted over the gyroscope measurement for orientation estimation.

Estimate orientation using an IMU Filter.
The block estimates device orientation and angular velocity by fusing the accelerometer and gyroscope data.
Tune the measurement noises to match a specific sensor. Tune the environmental noises to match the motion characteristics.

Estimate orientation from magnetometer and accelerometer readings.
The block estimates orientation that can rotate quantities from a global coordinate system to sensor body coordinate system.
Select the Reference frame as 'NED' or 'ENU' to specify the reference frame of the orientation output as North-East-Down or East-North-Up respectively. Select the Orientation format as 'quaternion' or 'Rotation matrix' to get the orientation as an N-by-4 quaternion element or a 3-by-3-by-N rotation matrix, respectively.
